title: MoCo: A One-Stop Shop for Model Collaboration Research
abstract: arXiv:2601.21257v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Advancing beyond single monolithic language models (LMs), recent research increasingly recognizes the importance of model collaboration, where multiple LMs collaborate, compose, and complement each other. Existing research on this topic has mostly been disparate and disconnected, from different research communities, and lacks rigorous comparison. To consolidate existing research and establish model collaboration as a school of thought, we present MoCo: a one-stop Python library of executing, benchmarking, and comparing model collaboration algorithms at scale. MoCo features 26 model collaboration methods, spanning diverse levels of cross-model information exchange such as routing, text, logit, and model parameters. MoCo integrates 25 evaluation datasets spanning reasoning, QA, code, safety, and more, while users could flexibly bring their own data. translated_title: MoCo：模型协作研究的一站式平台
translated_abstract: 超越单个单体语言模型，近期的研究日益认识到模型协作的重要性，即让多个语言模型相互协作、组合与互补。然而，现有关于这一主题的研究大多零散且相互割裂，来自不同的研究社区，缺乏严格的对比。为了整合现有研究并将模型协作确立为一个学派，我们提出了MoCo：一个用于大规模执行、基准测试和比较模型协作算法的一站式Python库。MoCo包含26种模型协作方法，涵盖不同层级的跨模型信息交换方式，如路由、文本、logit和模型参数。MoCo集成了25个评估数据集，覆盖推理、问答、代码、安全等多个领域，同时用户可以灵活地使用自己的数据。使用MoCo进行的大量实验表明，大多数协作策略的表现优于……
tldr: MoCo是一个一站式Python库，集成了26种模型协作方法和25个评估数据集，可大规模执行、基准测试和比较各类模型协作算法，推动模型协作成为统一的研究方向。
en_tdlr: MoCo is a one-stop Python library featuring 26 model collaboration methods and 25 evaluation datasets for executing, benchmarking, and comparing model collaboration algorithms at scale, establishing model collaboration as a unified school of thought.
